canada-dnd-shilo.n: CFB Shilo / Shilo Range and Training Area
canada-dnd-shilo.cp: NRCan Canadian Geographical Names Database (CGNDB) official feature GBIOE (Shilo Range and Training Area, MIL). Official named-feature point; not a surveyed installation or range footprint. (place_name_approx)
canada-dnd-shilo.st: Active Canadian Army training base. The official page says military activity in the region dates to 1910, describes CFB Shilo as being in southwestern Manitoba, 35 kilometres east of Brandon, and says it is a training venue for Third Canadian Division Training Centre, 38 Canadian Brigade Group, 4 Canadian Ranger Patrol Group, and other partners. No open IAAC public-comment period for Shilo was found on 2026-11-23.
canada-dnd-shilo.what: Coordinates are the official NRCan CGNDB military feature 'Shilo Range and Training Area' (GBIOE), not a surveyed footprint. A separately named official feature 'Canadian Forces Base Shilo' (GAZBG) is at 49.805556, -99.635556. The official DND UXO Legacy Sites inventory includes Shilo- Carberry Airfield (MB900-013 / 0366-X002), status In Assessment; that legacy record is kept as its own entry (canada-mb900-013) and is not merged into this active-base record. No official incident narrative for a specific munitions accident at Shilo was retrieved from the Government of Canada pages checked for this pass.
